Permits & License Committee  October 23, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 3

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 23, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Community Room # A 1St Floor
On October 23, 2025 at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Angel – Leon Martell, Planning Department.
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services/ Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on October 9, 2025

Held over from 10.23.25

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Zaniab Mohammed on behalf of Families for Children to host a Client Thanks Giving
  Celebration Event from 4th Avenue Parking are to 2500 W Manchester Blvd- Families for
  Children Agency; Public Property; on Wednesday, November 19, 2025, from 10:00 a.m. –
  2:30 p.m. Applicant must provide PWS with signatures, PWS request to remove stage from
  the application; item held over until November 13, 2025 P&L Meeting (Activity No. 00407038)

Item #2:  Shane Jenkins on behalf of Magic Johnson Foundation to host a Magic Johnson’s Holiday
  Hope Event at 400 Florence Ave; Faithful Central Bible Church; Private Property; on
  Saturday, November 22, 2025, from 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY;
  Approval for one (1) day event within private parking lot.; Approved; Applicant to hire two (2)
  police officers for public safety and four (4) TCO's for traffic control-safety (ingress / egress
  of vehicles coming to and from this event). Applicant to also hire adequate Faithful Central
  Church and or Magic Johnson Foundation security staff to assist IPD with any potential crowd
  control; None Code Enforcement Conditions; None conditions Fire Approval; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
 Permits & License Committee  October 23, 2025

  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00406615)

Item #3:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a City of Inglewood Turkey Giveaway
  Event at 1011 Stadium Dr; Private Property; on, Tuesday, November 25, 2025, from 9:00
  a.m. - 12:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within
  Hollywood Park parking lot; traffic control. **Approved; two (2) IPD officers for public safety
  and 2 TCO's for traffic safety / ingress-egress. This is a drive thru event and will not require
  CH security staffing this year. Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol provided
  as time permits; None Code Enforcement conditions; None conditions for Fire Approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO.
  Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00407043)

  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following list of
  business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax; adhere to all applicable
  IMC regulations, state and federal law and the standard recommendation applicable to
  each business type and all current LA County COVID19 guidelines. Motion carried
  unanimously

Item #4:  Business License Renewal Request (s):

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity
  No.
  1  Zeem Solutions  Auto/Rent Lease  00385563
  2  The Lounge Barbershop  Barber Shop  00385596

New Tobacco Retailer License Renewal Request (s):

Item #5:  Sahib 10 Inc. DBA Lindy’s Wine & Spirits to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 1400 Centinela
  Ave; This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition set
  forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood
  Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR
  BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all
  State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25%
  of total retail floor areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of
  Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored
  Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored
  Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own
  Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
 Permits & License Committee  October 23, 2025
Minutes  Page 3 of 3

  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21
  is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type of
  weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco
  use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable;NO
  loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00404941)

Revised Site Map Approval for City of Inglewood Pedicab:
Item #6:  Permits and Licensing Committee Members on behalf City of Inglewood to review and
  discuss the approval of the revised route Map for City of Inglewood Pedicabs; Motion carried
  unanimously to move forward with the revised map for City of Inglewood Pedicabs.

Public Comments

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was reported that there were no public
requests to speak.
